events.title: Build with AI 4.0 2026 – GDG Brisbane
events.description: This is a hands-on AI/tech community event run by Google Developer Groups Brisbane, providing a space for developers, curious minds, and AI enthusiasts to build and learn together.

events.title: BrisScience: How Shape Matters – An Introduction to Topology
events.location: The Edge, State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: BrisScience delivers engaging monthly lectures from local and international scientists. This month's talk is an accessible introduction to topology — the mathematics of shape and space — presented at The Edge.

events.title: Inner Harmony and Awareness Meditation
events.description: A grounded meditation session focused on cultivating inner harmony and awareness. This event offers a chance to practice mindfulness in a community setting, suitable for various experience levels.

events.title: River Walk - Botanic Gardens + South Bank
events.description: A social river walk through Brisbane's Botanic Gardens and South Bank, hosted by Brisbane Ramblers. Enjoy nature, exercise, and casual conversation in a relaxed group setting.

events.title: ASPG-Q: AI in Parliament – Risks, Opportunities and What's Next?
events.description: A panel event from ASPG-Q examining AI in Parliament — its risks, opportunities, and what's next. This is a timely public conversation about the intersection of artificial intelligence and democratic governance, ideal for curious and policy-minded attendees.

events.title: Ninajirachi (Live Electronic)
events.description: Brisbane-based producer Ninajirachi performs her intricate, layered electronic soundscapes in an intimate setting at The Princess Theatre, with shows on both Thursday and Friday.

events.title: Hannah Richell - An Ocean and a Day (Author Event)
events.description: Join author Hannah Richell as she discusses her latest book, "An Ocean and a Day," at the intimate Avid Reader Bookshop. Expect an insightful talk about her work, followed by Q&A and potentially a book signing.

events.title: Maker Mondays
events.description: Dive into the world of maker culture with this hands-on session, exploring technologies like 3D printing, laser cutting, and electronics. Connect with fellow enthusiasts and learn new skills in a collaborative environment.

events.title: Pop Choir Rehearsal Brisbane
events.source: Brisbane Classical and Chamber Music Meetup Group
events.description: Join the Brisbane Pop Choir for a rehearsal, perfect for anyone who loves to sing and wants to be part of a musical community. No experience typically necessary, just a passion for music.

events.title: CARNIVAL OF WORDS AUTHOR EXPO
events.description: A vibrant expo celebrating authors and the literary world, featuring readings, discussions, and opportunities to meet writers. Connect with the local writing and reading community in a lively market setting.

events.title: Clock Tower Tour
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane City Hall
events.description: Ascend to the top of Brisbane City Hall's iconic Clock Tower for a unique historical experience and panoramic views of the city. Bookings are essential for this free guided tour.

events.title: Abbey Medieval Festival
events.location: Abbey Museum of Art and Archaeology, Caboolture
events.description: Immerse yourself in history at this annual medieval festival featuring jousting, re-enactments, artisan markets, and period entertainment, fostering a strong sense of community.

events.title: Calile Culture: Institute of Modern Art Presents Daniel Crooks
events.description: An intimate cultural event at the Calile Hotel, blending contemporary art and ideas with a presentation by celebrated video and time-based media artist Daniel Crooks, in partnership with Brisbane's Institute of Modern Art.

events.title: Fuwa Fuwa! Art Market | Fuwaversary!
events.description: A celebration art market featuring independent creators, illustrators, and makers. This community-oriented creative market offers an intimate, indie atmosphere for discovering unique handmade goods.

events.title: House Blend: Jazz & Deep House Experience by Nouvelle Nights
events.description: A curated evening blending live jazz with deep house music in an intimate atmosphere. This event is perfect for music lovers seeking a sophisticated and atmospheric live experience.

events.title: Backstory Factory | Workshop | Brisbane Improv Festival 2026
events.description: A hands-on improv comedy workshop at the Brisbane Improv Festival, designed for creatives looking to build storytelling, character, and spontaneity skills in a playful environment.

events.title: Stageless Storytelling | Workshop | Brisbane Improv Festival 2026
events.description: This improv workshop from Brisbane's biggest improvised comedy festival explores storytelling without a formal stage, ideal for writers, performers, and curious creatives.

events.title: A Back Line – An Improvised Musical Genre | Workshop | Brisbane Improv Festival 2026
events.description: Part of the Brisbane Improv Festival, this workshop explores improvised musical genres, blending music, comedy, and spontaneous performance for creative expression.

events.title: Wynnum Fringe Festival (Final Week – running to 12 July)
events.source: Kids on the Coast / Urban List
events.description: The final week of Wynnum Fringe, transforming Brisbane's bayside into a buzzing hub of creativity, culture, and community with comedy, cabaret, music, circus, and three days of clowning workshops and performances.

events.title: The Films of John Cassavetes – Retrospective (Ongoing)
events.location: Brisbane (TBC — likely GOMA or Brisbane Powerhouse)
events.description: A landmark retrospective of actor/director John Cassavetes, offering a rare and intellectually stimulating film series for cinema lovers interested in independent filmmaking history and a new kind of realism.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence – Exhibition at GOMA (Ongoing to 12 July)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.source: Brisbane Airport Cultural Guide / The Urban List
events.description: This immersive exhibition by Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson invites visitors on an expansive, multi-sensory journey that engages perception. This free, must-see exhibition is closing this week.

events.title: Precious – Free Exhibition at Museum of Brisbane (Ongoing)
events.description: Museum of Brisbane's new major exhibition, 'Precious,' explores over 3,000 items from various collections, many displayed for the first time. It offers a charming glimpse into rare and intriguing objects usually hidden across Brisbane homes.

events.title: Platform 2026 — Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie & Seren Wagstaff
events.datetime: Tue 7 Jul – Sun 12 Jul, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.location: Institute of Modern Art (IMA), Fortitude Valley
events.description: The IMA's annual exhibition features ambitious new projects by Queensland emerging artists Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff, exploring themes like Melanesian mythologies, cultural displacement, and online subcultures through installations and soundscapes.

events.title: Platform 2026 Artist Talks
events.description: Join emerging artists Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff as they discuss their new works on display, offering a rare chance to hear directly from them in an intimate gallery setting.

events.title: Mandy Quadrio: Kukunna Wurraweena Exhibition
events.datetime: Tue 7 Jul – Sun 12 Jul, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.description: Mandy Quadrio's Kukunna Wurraweena project is on display at the IMA, a free public art gallery showcasing contemporary art installations.

events.title: Spanish & Latin American Film Festival
events.description: The 29th HSBC Spanish & Latin American Film Festival presents over thirty new films from Spain, Colombia, Argentina and more, showcasing arthouse and foreign language cinema.

events.title: Classic & Cult Cinema Weekly Screenings
events.location: Palace Barracks / Palace James St, Brisbane / Fortitude Valley
events.description: Hand-picked classic and cult films are screened weekly at Palace Cinemas, offering an alternative to mainstream blockbusters with international and art-house selections.

events.title: South Summit — 'RUN IT BACK' Australian Tour
events.description: South Summit brings their energetic indie/alternative live show to The Triffid, a beloved Brisbane venue known for its intimate atmosphere and quality independent acts.

events.title: billy woods (Armand Hammer)
events.description: Critically acclaimed underground hip-hop poet and lyricist billy woods delivers an intellectually compelling live rap performance at The Triffid.

events.title: Scott Bradlee's Postmodern Jukebox
events.description: Scott Bradlee's Postmodern Jukebox reimagines contemporary songs in vintage styles, featuring a rotating lineup of vocalists, instrumentalists, and dancers for a transportive experience.

events.title: Ben Kweller
events.description: Beloved American indie singer-songwriter Ben Kweller performs his confessional, emotionally rich alt-rock/folk at The Princess Theatre for what promises to be an intimate and heartfelt show.

events.title: Ninajirachi
events.description: Acclaimed Australian electronic producer and DJ Ninajirachi delivers an intricate, emotionally driven electronic music experience at The Princess Theatre, one of Brisbane's most atmospheric venues.

events.title: "Precious" Exhibition
events.datetime: Mon 6 Jul – Sun 12 Jul, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.description: Museum of Brisbane's major "Precious" exhibition showcases over 3,000 rare, beautiful, and intriguing items from 30 collections, honouring stories of local enthusiasts.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: Exclusive to Brisbane, this exhibition at GOMA features major installations, sculptures, and photo series that play with light, colour, and perception, inviting visitors to reflect on their sensory experience of the world. This is the last week of the exhibition.

events.title: Archie Moore: kith and kin
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: This ongoing exhibition at GOMA features the artist's extensive drawing, capturing the common ancestors of humans, animals, plants, and landforms to highlight our kinship responsibilities to our surroundings.

events.title: Darcy & Jer – Average At Best Tour
events.description: Darcy & Jer bring their "Average At Best Tour" to The Tivoli for a night of live comedy and musical performance.

events.title: Empowering Asian Language Speakers Symposium
events.description: This UQ symposium brings together academics, policymakers, and community members to discuss challenges and solutions for Asian language speakers in Australia, focusing on the reintegration of history into language teaching and learning.

events.title: Portrait of an Artist: Helga Groves – In Conversation
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Bank
events.description: Artist Helga Groves discusses her creative process, the role of field research, and how memory, environment, and abstraction influence her work, followed by an in-conversation and Q&A session at the State Library of Queensland.

events.title: Two World-Class Pianists: Jayson Gillham & Iyad Sughayer
events.description: Experience an intimate and high-calibre chamber piano performance featuring world-class pianists Jayson Gillham and Iyad Sughayer, celebrating music and friendship at QPAC.

events.title: Live Improv Comedy Night at QPAC
events.location: QPAC Studios / Cremorne Theatre, South Bank
events.description: An electric live improv comedy show featuring short-form games and shenanigans in QPAC's intimate studio venue, promising a wonderfully social experience.

events.title: BRISBANE MEETUP + CAFE EVENT
events.description: A casual Brisbane meetup in a cafe setting, offering a free sausage sizzle and drink specials. This is a chance to connect with new people and engage in relaxed conversation.

events.title: Language Exchange
events.description: An opportunity to meet others and practice different languages in a relaxed, social setting. Connect with language learners and native speakers to improve your conversational skills.

events.title: Open Mic Comedy!
events.description: Enjoy a night of live stand-up comedy at this open mic event, where emerging and established comedians test out new material. It's an intimate setting for a creative and entertaining experience.

events.title: Author Workshop with Peter Carnavas
events.description: Participate in a writing workshop led by author Peter Carnavas, offering insights and guidance on creative writing. Ideal for aspiring writers or anyone interested in the craft of storytelling.

events.title: Speak Easy International Language Exchange
events.description: A lively language exchange event to practice speaking different languages with both native speakers and learners. This recurring meetup fosters an open and friendly environment for cultural and linguistic exchange.

events.title: Street Philosophy Discussion Group (Online)
events.source: Street Philosophy - Life, the Universe and Everything Meetup
events.description: An online discussion group where participants delve into philosophical topics, hosted by the Street Philosophy Meetup. Engage in thoughtful conversation about life, the universe, and everything.

events.title: Improv QLD – Advanced Scene Work Course (Final Session, 11 July)
events.description: The final session of Improv QLD's advanced scene work course at The Exchange, building on skills for experienced improvisers within Brisbane's home of improvised comedy.

events.title: Improv QLD – Unleash Your Creativity Course (Final Session, 12 July)
events.description: The final session of this course at The Exchange, designed to help participants unleash their creativity and build upon foundational improvisation skills.

events.title: XCHANGE MARKET | Brisbane | July 12 | Vintage Fashion Market
events.description: A community vintage fashion market where independent sellers and buyers gather to exchange pre-loved clothing and accessories, fostering a relaxed, creative, and social atmosphere.

events.title: Dearly Departed – Free Exhibition at State Library of Queensland (Ongoing)
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: A fascinating free exhibition at the State Library of Queensland, featuring the often-taboo subjects of death and dying. This thought-provoking show is designed to spark conversation for curious minds.

events.title: Jeremy Loops
events.description: South African folk-pop singer-songwriter Jeremy Loops performs his soulful, loop-pedal-driven music in an intimate gig at The Triffid, one of Brisbane's best mid-size live music venues.

events.title: Hiatus Kaiyote
events.description: Melbourne's legendary neo-soul/jazz-fusion outfit, Hiatus Kaiyote, performs at The Tivoli as part of Open Season 2026, offering a genre-defying live act with an intensely devoted following.

events.title: Deafheaven (USA) w/ Nothing (USA) & Spy
events.description: A rare Brisbane appearance from critically acclaimed US post-metal/shoegaze band Deafheaven, joined by Nothing and Spy, for a special live event at The Princess Theatre as part of Open Season 2026.

events.title: Solarstone
events.description: UK trance/electronic music icon Solarstone performs at The Brightside, offering a night of melodic and progressive trance at an intimate Valley venue.

events.title: Mystique — Magic and Illusion Spectacular
events.description: Mystique brings a theatrical magic and illusion show to Fortitude Music Hall, featuring sleight of hand, stagecraft, and immersive live entertainment at an atmospheric venue.

events.title: Gretta Ziller
events.location: New Farm Bowls Club, New Farm
events.description: Gretta Ziller, a folk/Americana singer-songwriter, performs at the New Farm Bowls Club, offering an intimate show with a relaxed, community atmosphere and quality original music.

events.title: Divine Exhibition
events.datetime: Tue 7 Jul – Sun 12 Jul, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.description: QAGOMA's free Divine exhibition explores faith and visual culture across various cultures, featuring stunning and rare oleographs from the late 1800s.

events.title: State Library of Queensland – Building Tour
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Bank
events.description: Join a volunteer guide for a tour of the State Library of Queensland, exploring its award-winning architecture, collections, services, and current exhibitions, customizable to visitor interests.

events.title: International Meetup with Activities
events.description: A social gathering designed for international individuals and locals to connect, engage in activities, and enjoy free snacks. A great opportunity to meet diverse people and make new friends.

events.title: Fancy Retro Revival - 2 DJ's
events.description: Enjoy a night of retro music with two DJs at the Doo-Bop Basement Bar, hosted by Fancy 40's-50's. Expect a lively atmosphere and a chance to dance to classic tunes.

events.title: QLD Baroque Orchestra Performance
events.source: Brisbane Classical and Chamber Music Meetup Group
events.description: Experience a performance by the QLD Baroque Orchestra, offering a rich and authentic interpretation of classical baroque music. Enjoy a high-art cultural experience in Brisbane.

events.title: Kindred Fields | Sarah Hickey & Clairy Laurence (Art Exhibition)
events.description: An exhibition showcasing new works by artists Sarah Hickey and Clairy Laurence at Field Trip Gallery. Explore contemporary art and design in a vibrant local gallery setting.

events.title: Franck Gohier | 'Australia Has Cowboys Too' (Art Exhibition)
events.description: Discover the latest exhibition by Franck Gohier, titled 'Australia Has Cowboys Too', featuring his distinctive artistic style. This show offers a unique cultural perspective through visual art.

events.title: Carolyn Craig: Becoming Penguin (Act II) (Art Exhibition)
events.description: An intriguing exhibition by Carolyn Craig, "Becoming Penguin (Act II)," inviting viewers to engage with contemporary themes. Visit PARKER Contemporary for an thought-provoking artistic experience.

events.title: Nicole McPherson | Sky Woman (Art Exhibition)
events.description: View "Sky Woman," an exhibition by Nicole McPherson at Revival Art & Design Gallery. This presentation explores significant themes through visual art in a unique gallery space.

events.title: Taste of QAGOMA: Tour + Lunch Experience
events.description: Enjoy a curated tour of QAGOMA's current exhibitions, followed by a lunch experience. This event combines art appreciation with a social dining component.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour Olafur Eliasson – Presence
events.description: Join a volunteer-led tour to delve deeper into the 'Olafur Eliasson: Presence' exhibition at GOMA. Gain insights into the artworks and the artist's conceptual approach.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour Seeing Art, Seeing Ourselves
events.description: Participate in a free guided tour at QAG that encourages reflective engagement with art, exploring how artworks mirror and influence our perceptions of ourselves. This tour fosters thoughtful interaction with the collection.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour Collection Snapshot
events.description: A brief, free guided tour highlighting key artworks from the QAGOMA collection. This snapshot tour provides a concise overview of significant pieces across both galleries.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour Art in Focus - Stories, Symbols & Perspectives
events.description: This free guided tour at QAG focuses on specific artworks, exploring their stories, symbols, and various perspectives. It encourages a deeper understanding and appreciation of art history and meaning.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour QAG Highlights
events.description: Take a free guided tour highlighting significant works and stories from the Queensland Art Gallery's collection. Discover key pieces and learn about their cultural and artistic importance.

events.title: Twilight Rockclimb & Abseil Adventure
events.description: Join an exhilarating twilight rock climbing and abseiling adventure at Kangaroo Point Cliffs, perfect for adventurers seeking a social and active outdoor experience.

events.title: Yoga Brisbane City – 5:30pm Tuesday 7th July
events.description: An after-work yoga session in the Brisbane CBD, offering a grounded and community-oriented approach to wellness and movement.

events.title: Hiatus Kaiyote (Live Concert)
events.description: Melbourne neo-soul/jazz fusion band Hiatus Kaiyote performs a warm, intimate, and genre-defying live experience at The Tivoli, appealing to music connoisseurs worldwide.

events.title: Cradle of Filth + DevilDriver (Live Concert)
events.description: A heavy double-bill featuring internationally acclaimed metal acts Cradle of Filth (UK) and DevilDriver (USA) performing at The Tivoli, offering a high-energy live music experience.

events.title: Heritage Talks: The Ekka Through History
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Bank
events.description: A panel discussion facilitated by David Fagan at the State Library of Queensland, exploring the Ekka's place in Queensland's social and agricultural history, from its origins as an exhibition to its current form.

events.title: GOMA – Free French-Speaking Gallery Tour
events.location: Queensland Art Gallery (QAG) or GOMA, South Bank
events.description: Join a QAGOMA French-speaking guide for a free highlights tour of the Queensland Art Gallery or Gallery of Modern Art, offering a unique, intimate engagement with major exhibitions.

events.title: GOMA – General Volunteer Guide Tours
events.description: Explore QAGOMA's free collection displays with a general volunteer guide tour, part of the gallery's daily program which also includes workshops and screenings (check calendar for times).

events.title: QSO – Daphnis and Chloé / MacMillan Percussion Concerto
events.description: The Queensland Symphony Orchestra performs Ravel's sweeping ballet score, Daphnis and Chloé, alongside James MacMillan's First Percussion Concerto for a richly orchestral and artistic evening.

events.title: Fortnightly Collage Sessions with A/pART Collective
events.description: Engage in creative expression at these fortnightly collage sessions hosted by the A/pART Collective. Participants will experiment with various materials and techniques in a supportive community environment.

events.title: The Descent of Orpheus (Performance)
events.description: An artistic performance titled "The Descent of Orpheus," promising a unique and atmospheric live experience. Immerse yourself in a creative interpretation of the classic myth.

events.title: Brisbane Stoics July 2026 Meetup
events.location: Meeting room adjacent to New Farm library.
events.description: A monthly meetup for the Brisbane Stoics group to discuss Stoic philosophy and its application to modern life. Engage in stimulating conversation and connect with like-minded individuals.

events.title: d harding. 'Site, Non Site, Place' (Art Exhibition)
events.description: Explore the exhibition 'Site, Non Site, Place' by d harding at Milani Gallery, delving into conceptual art and spatial relationships. This gallery presents thought-provoking contemporary works.

events.title: School Dance
events.description: Experience Queensland Theatre's production of 'School Dance', a contemporary play exploring themes relevant to youth culture and identity. This mainstream theatre performance offers a strong artistic experience.

events.title: Pride & Prejudice
events.description: Queensland Theatre presents a classic adaptation of Jane Austen's 'Pride & Prejudice', offering a romantic and witty theatrical experience for mainstream audiences.

events.title: NAIDOC Week 2026 - Evidence, Voices and Justice
events.location: OJW Room, Level 12, S Block, QUT Gardens Point Campus
events.description: Join QUT for a NAIDOC Week event exploring themes of evidence, voices, and justice within Indigenous Australian contexts. This promises to be an intellectually stimulating discussion on culture, history, and human rights.

events.title: XCHANGE MARKET | Vintage Fashion
events.description: Explore curated vintage fashion and support sustainable style at this market held at Superordinary, a hub for Brisbane's creative community.

events.title: BIYMF 2026 Winners Concert and Award Ceremony – Brisbane City Hall
events.description: The prestigious Brisbane International Youth Music Festival's winners concert, showcasing exceptional young musical talent in the grand surrounds of Brisbane City Hall.

events.title: Anywhere Festival – Ongoing Performances
events.description: Anywhere Festival champions artists by transforming unexpected Brisbane locations—from ferries to backyards—into stages for theatre, circus, music, and storytelling, offering unique and immersive performances.

events.title: Dining Philosophers
events.description: A social dinner event hosted by Brisbane Social Geeks, where participants can engage in philosophical discussions over a meal. A great opportunity for thoughtful conversation and community building.

events.title: Aloha Brisbane – Language Exchange & Social
events.description: A weekly language exchange and social event for people aged 18-35, held at a rooftop bar. Practice languages, meet new friends, and enjoy a vibrant atmosphere.
